# Schedule a cron task


<Note>
  In 0.25 the cron worker still publishes the `cron` trigger type, so you bind a function to a
  schedule with `registerTrigger({ type: "cron", function_id, config: { expression } })`.
  `registerTrigger` is deprecated and logs one warning per process, but it is the supported way to
  use cron until the cron worker ships its source function. When it does, existing registrations keep
  working and you can move them to [observers](../using-iii/observers); see [Upgrading from
  0.24.x](../upgrading/from-0-24-x#providers-not-migrated-yet).
</Note>
